verdict.rationale: Supabase's own docs describe an open source AI toolkit built on Postgres and pgvector. They say developers can use the client libraries to store, index, and query vector embeddings at scale, and the homepage lists 'Vector embeddings' as a core product component. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of similarity-search operators, distance metrics and index types (e.g. HNSW/IVFFlat), and independent or hands-on corroboration of vector search performance.

support.subject: As a developer, I can store embeddings and run vector similarity search for AI features

citations.quote: Supabase provides an open source toolkit for developing AI applications using Postgres and pgvector.
Use the Supabase client libraries to store, index, and query your vector embeddings at scale.
Add Authentication, Data APIs, Edge Functions, Realtime Data, Storage, and Vector embeddings.
